Using the Grouping Feature

Grouping allows the user to allocate two or more devices to one of twelve available groups. All devices that are members of the same group will have exactly the same settings and are always edited in parallel automatically.

If you are in the setup mode, some windows have VU-Meters. The VU data is always received from that device, that is marked with a green bar on it’s left side on the PC screen. To change the device from which to receive VU data, simply click on the device.
